development_notes: Initial full run: 391 tested, 293 caught, 46 unviable, 13 timeouts, 39 survivors. Investigated gaps in exact quota boundaries, invalidation/bypass accounting, probe metrics/positions, and multi-chunk/Unicode edit boundaries.

The broad integration rerun retained two survivors in syntax_state. A focused two-mutant attempt caught one; an added symmetric deletion case and equivalent simplification to common_length - prefix removed the remaining gap. The complete updated syntax_state module was then retested with no survivors.

Other nine module bodies match the recorded broad-run hashes. Final syntax_state changes also conservatively change embedded analyzer fingerprints. Phases overlap and must not be summed as unique mutations.
limits: Timeouts cover startup fixtures without complete analysis and deliberately broken admission/diff loops; they are separate from assertion-detected mutants.
Macro-expanded fingerprints/JSON, grammar/dependency internals, OS watchers, browser execution, and Python driver logic are outside this Rust mutation scope.
The full integration phase itself has two recorded survivors; both are resolved by the complete updated-module rerun. This is not a single full-suite zero-survivor run of all final source files.
